## Analysis Performed
- The correct answer is "avait" (plus-que-parfait), which is the standard construction for "À peine...que" when the main clause is in passé composé
- Answer B ("était") is incorrect because "comprendre" uses "avoir" as its auxiliary, not "être"
- Answer C ("aurait") is incorrect because it expresses a hypothetical condition (conditionnel passé), but the context describes actual events
- Answer D ("eut") is incorrect because it creates the passé antérieur, which is only used when the main clause is also in passé simple (literary style), not passé composé
